title: Koko Eating Bananas
description: Find the minimum integer k such that Koko can eat all bananas within h hours.

steps.note: Initialize binary search range [1, 11] for piles [3, 6, 7, 11] and h = 8.
Calculate mid = 6. Check if Koko can eat all bananas in 8 hours at speed 6.
Hours needed at speed 6: ceil(3/6)+ceil(6/6)+ceil(7/6)+ceil(11/6) = 1+1+2+2 = 6 hours.
Hours 6 <= 8, so set right = 6 to look for a smaller speed.
Calculate mid = 3. Check if speed 3 works.
Hours needed at speed 3: ceil(3/3)+ceil(6/3)+ceil(7/3)+ceil(11/3) = 1+2+3+4 = 10 hours.
Calculate mid = 5. Check if speed 5 works.
Hours needed at speed 5: ceil(3/5)+ceil(6/5)+ceil(7/5)+ceil(11/5) = 1+2+2+3 = 8 hours.
Calculate mid = 4. Check if speed 4 works.
Hours needed at speed 4: ceil(3/4)+ceil(6/4)+ceil(7/4)+ceil(11/4) = 1+2+2+3 = 8 hours.
